content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen is clean and photo-led but ends in a dead band below the intro with no action above the fixed bar, and the hours timeline wastes vertical space with six near-identical rows.","desktopNote":"The hero is a tidy image-plus-text split, but the story section leaves a large empty left column under short text while the photo stretches on, and the hours timeline is oversized for six rows.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Compress the opening-hours timeline into a compact two-column list (or shorter bars) so it doesn't take a full screen on phone and desktop.","Balance the 'Salon, ki ga je odprla Mia Golob' section on desktop: shorten the photo or add content/quote so the text column doesn't sit in a void.","Give the team section faces (portraits of Mia and Ana) and tighten the dead space between the phone hero text and the next section."],"blockers":[]}
